title: Checkout 5xx spike during afternoon traffic

label.explanation: The external card processor (api.cardproc.example) began responding slowly (lines 7, 8, 12) and then timing out at 30s (lines 9, 13, 25). payment-svc's charge calls to it hung, so order-service's PaymentClient calls to payment-svc timed out too (lines 10, 14, 16). Everything after is downstream symptom: failed charges requeue to orders.retry, order-service's HTTP connection pool to payment-svc saturates (lines 17-19), and api-gateway surfaces 503s on /checkout (lines 20, 21, 23) which is what paged. The pool exhaustion is resource_exhaustion but it is secondary; the slow postgres query (line 6) and the order-service v2.4.1 start at 08:30 (line 1, ~45 min before onset) are red herrings, not the cause.
